note: H5P provides an 'h5p' field type (widget h5p_upload, formatter h5p_default) backed by an h5p_content entity, plus a global config object h5p.settings (h5p_export, h5p_default_path, h5p_save_content_state, h5p_send_usage_statistics, ...) at /admin/config/system/h5p, and a rich permission set (administer h5p libraries, results, copy/download/embed). The external H5P content-type libraries / Hub are NOT installed here, so medium/hard cases are grounded in LOCAL state only: the h5p.settings config and the h5p field type (creating a field needs no content-type library). Namespaced with 'field_h5p_' / value probes.

evals.prompt: How do you attach interactive H5P content to a Drupal content type, and what are the machine name of the field type and its default widget and formatter?
evals.expected_output: Add a field of type 'h5p' (label 'Interactive Content – H5P') to the bundle; its default widget is h5p_upload and default formatter is h5p_default. Each value references an h5p_content entity.

evals.prompt: Where are H5P's global settings stored and at what admin path is its configuration form?
evals.expected_output: In the config object h5p.settings; the form is at /admin/config/system/h5p (route h5p.admin.config.system.h5p, permission 'administer site configuration').

evals.prompt: Which H5P permission lets a user upload, update, delete and restrict H5P content-type libraries at /admin/content/h5p?
evals.expected_output: The 'administer h5p libraries' permission (restricted access) controls the H5P library administration page.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the H5P storage directory has been changed from its default. Inspect the live H5P configuration and state the current H5P default path value.
evals.expected_output: h5p.settings h5p_default_path is 'lessons' (default is 'h5p'); read with `drush cget h5p.settings h5p_default_path`.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, is H5P currently configured to autosave learners' content state (so they can resume)? Inspect the live configuration and state the value of the relevant setting.
evals.expected_output: h5p.settings h5p_save_content_state is 1 (enabled); read with `drush cget h5p.settings h5p_save_content_state`.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, add an H5P (Interactive Content) field named 'field_h5p_task' to the Article content type so editors can attach interactive H5P content to articles. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create a FieldStorageConfig (entity_type node, field_name field_h5p_task, type 'h5p') and a FieldConfig on bundle article; the field type 'h5p' is provided by the module (no content-type library needed to create the field).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure H5P so the Download (export) button is never shown, by setting the H5P export display option to 0. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set h5p.settings h5p_export to 0, e.g. `drush cset h5p.settings h5p_export 0 -y` or ConfigFactory getEditable('h5p.settings')->set('h5p_export', 0)->save().
